title: Signatures, end to end
eyebrow: Wisconsin Creative · local workflow review · September 28, 2026
lede: A sequential pass from roster import through signing, recovery, private files, and lifecycle management. Changes are local; production and physical Pencil acceptance remain separate.

stats.n: Eight Signatures and app-shell files pass.
Save stays in the viewport; no page scroll required.
Controlled preview environment; no migrations or deployment.

sections.heading: Import and find the right signer
sections.note: Matched desktop dimensions, synthetic ADMIN session, fixture data, search/selection, and scroll position. Source snapshot hashes and image hashes are attached to each pair. These are local captures, not deployed build evidence.

pairs.title: Changing season discards the old preview
pairs.sub: Both views have switched from the reviewed 2026–27 roster to 2027–28.
pairs.beforeCap: Apply still targets the old preview while the selector shows the new season.
pairs.afterCap: The old preview is cleared. A new preview is required before Apply.

pairs.title: Search reveals collapsed matches
pairs.sub: Student-Athletes was collapsed before entering the same signer name.
pairs.beforeCap: The group count matches, but the signer remains hidden.
pairs.afterCap: The matching row opens. Status filters find unfinished or signed work, and disclosure controls remain usable.

sections.heading: Review the actual roster
sections.note: After-only evidence: authenticated MHKY/2026-27 Preview/Apply in the isolated environment produced 26 active members. No signatures were created by this import check.

shots.title: Review import members
shots.cap: Sport, season, and individual members are visible before Apply.

sections.heading: Signing and recovery on iPad
sections.note: After-only visual evidence at 1180×820. Chromium uses iPad detection and pen-class CDP input; save responses are intercepted. The original full-page capture was 1180×960, so it is not presented as a matched visual pair. Physical Pencil, touch, rotation, and Safari acceptance remain open.

shots.title: Signing retains draft after a timeout
shots.cap: The canvas, controls, and Save fit together. An ambiguous response or 45-second timeout retains the ink and save request ID.

sections.heading: Management stays recoverable
sections.note: After-only fixtures: server settingsLocked=true with no current artifacts, followed by a simulated reset failure. This proves UI recovery, not real erasure.

shots.title: Settings lock follows the server
shots.cap: Individual erasure does not falsely unlock pen settings. Reset remains available when the server lock requires it.

shots.title: Failed reset keeps its confirmation
shots.cap: The failure appears inside the still-open dialog. Controls are available again for retry or cancel.

changes.h: Keep the version that the signer started with
changes.was: Reconnect could move an in-progress draft from capture version 0 onto version 1, weakening stale-save protection.
changes.now: The browser keeps version 0 and its ink, receives a conflict, and requires deliberate reopening before replacing another capture.

changes.h: Make shared and retained signature state consistent
changes.was: An erased canonical signature could fall back to an old team artifact; removed-member history was hard to reach; cleanup skipped historical committed operations.
changes.now: Canonical blank state stays authoritative, Removed from roster exposes retained history, and pending-delete cleanup can retry after erasure.

changes.h: Fence destructive lifecycle actions and bound exports
changes.was: A new save did not advance the collection version; ZIP size was checked after files were buffered, and case-only names could collide on extraction.
changes.now: Every commit advances the collection version. ZIP reads stop at the 50 MiB budget and names are unique without case sensitivity.

verification: 125 focused tests pass, including shared AppShell consumers. Nine regression cases fail as expected against the original service implementation (eight lifecycle cases plus the streaming budget check).
TypeScript and scoped ESLint pass. The controlled optimized app build generates 262 pages.

Authenticated browser checks cover real Preview/Apply, collapsed search and filters, locked settings/reset failure fixtures, reconnect version retention, non-JSON response handling, timeout recovery, and viewport fit. Keyboard Space toggles a filtered group without losing its matching row.
The live-test runner passed read-only preflight: exact preview branch, isolated storage configured, and ADHOC/2032-33 unused. Execution remains pending explicit approval.
notes: Full-repository ESLint has an existing error in vendored public/qrcode/vendor/jsQR.js. Unrelated dirty work is preserved.
Real new private artifact save/download/erase/reset/archive acceptance is prepared in live-test-plan.md, but automatic approval review rejected execution without explicit authorization.
No commit, push, deployment, production mutation, or physical-device claim is made.
